# Landing typefaces

Self-hosted so the Content-Security-Policy can stay same-origin — no
`fonts.googleapis.com` or `fonts.gstatic.com` exception is needed, and no
third-party host sees a request from a signed-out visitor.

| Family | Weights | Source | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Instrument Sans | 400, 500, 600, 700 | `@fontsource/instrument-sans` | OFL-1.1 |
| Instrument Serif | 400, 400 italic | `@fontsource/instrument-serif` | OFL-1.1 |
| IBM Plex Mono | 400, 500 | `@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono` | OFL-1.1 |

Latin subset only, `woff2` only. 164 KB total, all eight faces.
Licence texts are kept beside the files.
